decisions.reason: Requiring a standard PH battery connector does not change the existing electrical or thermal battery-protection behavior.
Battery connector compatibility does not alter charge-status indication through the main-board LED chain.
The battery connector standard does not change ESP32 sleep policy, power states, or wake sources.
Selecting PH for battery compatibility does not modify the required TVS ESD protection.
The battery connector choice does not affect the software-switched 5V sensor rail or its control behavior.
The candidate already requires an L-shaped battery JST placement, and the source only adds a battery-standard compatibility rationale without changing placement, orientation, spacing, or access.
The source establishes battery compatibility through the PH standard, not a new sourcing or availability rule; the candidate's existing sourcing policy remains unchanged.
The battery is explicitly an exception, so the compact connector selection for actual interboard connections remains unchanged.
The battery connector standard has no effect on native USB data lines or programming behavior.
